title: fix(cli): os lint --item hint names the draft publish verdict; SDK draft-read example casts item
body:
Fixes #35704

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 逐条写元数据的开发者看到的两处文字变了:接口文档里的草稿读取示例可以直接照抄编译;单条检查命令的提示不再让人去发布草稿,而是指向只看发布判定、不上线的草稿保存命令。
- 为什么做:上一轮逐条编写草稿功能评审里接受的两条措辞问题,替照着文档和提示走的开发者纠正去向。
- 出错会怎样:只是文字和示例,行为不变;出问题直接撤回即可。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

- `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx`: the draft-read example casts `draft.item` before reading `_diagnostics?.valid`, the same cast `draftPublishVerdictOf` in `packages/cli/src/commands/meta/register.ts` uses. `GetMetaItemResponse.item` is typed `unknown`, so the old line did not compile (TS18046).
- `packages/cli/src/commands/lint.ts`: the `os lint --item` text face's closing hint under "Not run without the rest of the stack" now reads: Run `os lint` on the project for those, or `os meta register TYPE --data FILE --mode draft --package ID` to read their publish verdict without publishing. TYPE and FILE are filled from the run (the `--item` file is the body `--data` takes, per the `--item` flag description). The flag spelling was measured from `register.ts`: a TYPE argument, `--data`, `--package`, `--mode` options `draft|publish`.
- JSON face: it carries no hint today (`judged`, `notJudged`, `familiesNotRun` only), so per the card's "if it has one" nothing is added there.
- `.changeset/35704-lint-item-draft-hint.md`: `@objectstack/cli` patch.

Read first (by risk):
1. `packages/cli/src/commands/lint.ts`, the one hint hunk near the "Not run without the rest of the stack" block.
2. `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx`, the "Per-item draft lifecycle" lines.

Two-minute check: `os lint --item some-object.json --type object` in any project prints, as its last dim line under "Not run without the rest of the stack", a line naming `os meta register object --data some-object.json --mode draft --package` and no "publish the draft".

## Tests

- `packages/cli/test/lint-item.test.ts`: the text-face case now also asserts the output contains `--mode draft --package` plus the id placeholder and does not contain "publish the draft". The old wording was not pinned before.

## Acceptance notes

- The doc snippet was type-checked against the built `@objectstack/client` `dist` in a throwaway file (deleted after): the new lines compile; the old line, kept in the same file as a control, fails with `TS18046: 'draft.item' is of type 'unknown'`.
- No ablation: the changed behaviour is display text; the test pins its presence.

## Verification

- Closure build `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/cli^...' build` then `vitest run test/lint-item.test.ts` (Test Files 1 passed, Tests 11 passed) and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` (tsc + check:test-typecheck OK), all under the verify lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, on `fb149e01` (after merging origin/main `bbc7e037`).
- Derived gate families (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`): 98 derived on `fb149e01`; 91 exit 0; 7 refused with PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3, NOT MEASURED, declared narrowing to CI: they read dist of packages outside this diff, or need a deeper clone): `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (needs unshallow), spec `check:skill-examples` (client-react dist), `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-coverage`, `check:i18n-walk-parity`, `check:type-check-debt`. `--ran` reconciliation: 98 derived, 91 run, 7 UNRUN (those seven).
- CI owns the full farm, `test:repo`, `pnpm lint` and the integration tier of `packages/cli`.
